newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada to invest C$500 mln on tourism.
newsitem.headline: Canada to invest C$500 mln on tourism.

text.p: The Canadian government said on Wednesday that it formed a private sector partnership to invest up to C$500 million over five years in the tourism industry.
Half the money would come from the federal government's Business Development Bank, Industry Minister John Manley said in a statement.
The government would put forward C$50 million and the rest would come from private industry sources, Manley said.

Loans ranging from C$500,000 to C$5 million would go to high-quality projects located outside major cities across Canada for expanding or upgrading tourist facilities so they could attract more international tourists, the minister said.
Some of the loans would go to ventures that are too high- risk for the chartered banks, he added.
Tourism accounts for about three percent of Canada's gross domestic product.
